channel_access_settings_list:
`enabled` true/false
`approvals` number of approving votes needed
`denials` number of denying votes needed
`votehours` how long a vote stays open, 0 for no limit
`onexpiry` deny / majority / stayopen
`reviewchannel` channel applications post in
`logchannel` channel decisions are logged to
`voterrole` role allowed to vote
`pingrole` role pinged on new applications
`anonymousapplicant` true/false
`anonymousvotes` true/false
`allowabstain` true/false
`minaccountage` days
`minserverage` days
`reapplycooldown` hours
`dmondecision` true/false
